value.rationale: Exact structural static capacity for all fixed-point-free permutation incidence classes and sharp first adaptive departure at n=5. The crown graph is a natural simplest dense matching graph obtained by forbidding a prescribed perfect matching, and the result pinpoints how positive-and-negative matching constraints affect learnability. A complete n5 witness and all-n optimal static supports support further comparison.
